gloss: the whole world, the land; supremacy, rule

definitions.gloss: the whole world, the land, the realm
definitions.explanation: Refers to the entire world or country. In historical contexts, it specifically means the realm or domain under a ruler's control.
The state of having supreme power or being the best. Used in expressions about taking control or being unrivaled.

examples.japanese: {天下|てんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名城|めいじょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: It is known as one of the greatest castles in the land.

examples.japanese: {天下|てんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧しめた⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a military commander who made his name known throughout the land.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天下|てんか}⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This ramen is said to be the finest in the world.

examples.japanese: {天下|てんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: To seize power; to rule the land.

examples.japanese: {織田信長|おだのぶなが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天下|てんか}⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}した→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: Oda Nobunaga aimed to unify the realm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}って→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧、⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧{天下|てんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: After winning the match, he celebrated as if he had conquered the world.

notes:
{天下|てんか} literally means "under heaven" and refers to the entire world or realm.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {天下|てんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to seize power, to conquer the realm
- {天下|てんか}⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧: unification of the realm
- {天下|てんか}{一品|いっぴん}: the finest in the world
- {天下|てんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: of/in the whole world (intensifier, "the greatest")
- {天下|てんか}{泰平|たいへい}: peace throughout the land

CULTURAL NOTE:
Deeply associated with Japan's Sengoku (Warring States) period, when rival warlords competed for {天下|てんか}⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧ (unification of the realm). The phrase {天下|てんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ is still used figuratively to mean achieving dominance or great success.
